integrity: Complete derivation, finite independent enumerator, and same-model review; not an independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the involution-induced permutahedron under neighboring position swaps only. The Poisson limit is for uniform involutions and uses an explicit elementary induction for the needed involution-number ratio; exhaustive checks reach n=9, not all n. Earlier unindexed equivalent theorems cannot be ruled out.
title: Fibonacci-cube components and a Poisson mobility law for involutions in the permutahedron
